name: Required Asbestos Testing
description:
Provide allowance for asbestos testing of existing materials in areas affected by construction, including but not limited to siding, flooring, drywall, insulation and other potentially impacted building components.

Testing to be performed by a licensed third-party testing agency in accordance with applicable regulations. Scope includes sample collection and laboratory analysis.

Abatement or removal of hazardous materials, if identified, is not included and will be addressed under separate contract or change order.

name: Site Preparation, Access & Material Handling
description: Provide site setup including erosion control monitoring and documentation, protection of existing surfaces, Dust control and establishment of safe work areas. Coordinate and manage all material deliveries, staging, and transport of materials from delivery point to work area, including hand-carrying materials where access is limited. Maintain site organization, safety, and access throughout construction.

name: Demo
description:
Remove existing kitchen cabinets and finishes to exposed wall framing, and fully demolish mudroom structure including, old chimney, down to foundation walls. Scope includes all labor and equipment required to complete demolition and site cleanup, including sorting and staging of debris for removal.

Work to be performed in a controlled manner to protect adjacent structures. Any unforeseen conditions, including hidden structural, plumbing, or electrical elements, may require additional work.

name: Existing Basement Access Modification Allowance
description: Provide labor, equipment, and materials required to perform limited modification of existing foundation and access conditions for the revised basement access configuration. Scope is based on utilizing the existing doorway/opening where feasible to reduce demolition, excavation, and structural impact. Work may include limited concrete cutting, minor demolition, light excavation, debris removal, and preparation of the access area for revised construction. Final scope may be adjusted based on field conditions discovered during work.

name: Framing Lumber, Windows and Doors Package
Lumber, Framing & Siding Material Package
description:
Provide materials required for structural framing modifications to the existing residence including floor system components, wall framing lumber, structural beams and posts, roof framing associated with the primary structure, exterior sheathing, and weather barrier systems.

Scope excludes previously proposed exterior deck framing and associated roof structure.

Includes house wrap, flashing, and related components required for proper integration of exterior assemblies. Roof trusses to be provided as an allowance and supplied separately. All materials to be installed in accordance with manufacturer specifications and applicable building codes.

Material quantities are based on current plans and supplier takeoffs. Any adjustments required due to field conditions, plan revisions, or material availability may result in cost adjustments.

name: Structural Framing Labor Allowance
description:
Provide all labor required for layout, fabrication, and installation of structural framing components including walls, headers, beams, and modifications associated with the primary structure and new truss system.

Scope excludes exterior deck framing, stair systems, and associated roof structures previously proposed.

name: Windows & Doors – Supply and Installation Allowance
description:
Provide all labor, materials, and equipment for procurement and installation of new windows and doors as indicated in project plans. Scope includes installation of new energy-efficient windows and exterior doors, including double entry door assembly and associated hardware preparation, as well as installation of interior pocket door system.

Includes all necessary flashing, sealing, shimming, and integration with adjacent framing and weather barrier systems to ensure proper performance and weather resistance. All work to be installed plumb, level, and in accordance with manufacturer specifications and applicable building codes.

Final window and door selections, sizes, and configurations to be confirmed prior to order. Any changes, lead time impacts, or cost adjustments due to manufacturer availability or client revisions may be addressed as needed.

Final selections, sizes, and configurations to be confirmed prior to order.

name: Material Price Volatility Allowance (Market Conditions)
description: This project includes materials subject to market volatility, including petroleum-based products, piping, and other commodities impacted by supply chain conditions and tariffs. Pricing is based on current supplier quotes. Any significant cost increases prior to material procurement will be reviewed with the Owner and addressed through a Change Order prior to purchase.

name: Exterior Wall Assembly & Siding Installation Allowance
description:
Provide labor to complete the exterior wall assembly and siding installation for designated areas as shown on plans. Scope includes installation of wall sheathing, weather-resistive barrier (house wrap), and integration with existing construction to create a continuous weather-resistant envelope.

Install metal flashing at all windows, doors, and penetrations as required, including head flashing (drip cap), sill protection, and integration with the weather-resistive barrier to direct water away from openings. All flashing to be installed in accordance with manufacturer specifications and best practices.

Provide sealant (caulking) at joints, seams, trim interfaces, and around window and door perimeters as required to achieve a weather-tight installation. Sealants to be applied in a neat and workmanlike manner.

Install lap siding and associated trim components including corner boards, window and door trim, starter strips, and all necessary accessories. Scope includes layout, cutting, fitting, fastening, and alignment of all materials to ensure a clean, consistent, and code-compliant installation.

Work to be coordinated with adjacent construction elements and installed in accordance with manufacturer specifications and industry standards. All areas to be left clean and ready for final finishing.

Excludes repair of concealed damage or deteriorated framing discovered during installation.

name: Roofing Package Allowance
description:
Roofing Installation – Revised Roof Areas
Provide labor and materials to install new roofing system at revised roof areas associated with the primary structure and basement access only. Scope includes sheathing, underlayment, drip edge, composition roofing, required flashing, and tie-in to adjacent roof/siding conditions. Excludes previously proposed patio/deck cover roof structure.

Roofing to be installed in accordance with manufacturer specifications and current building code requirements, including proper fastening, layout, and ventilation as applicable.

Coordinate integration with adjacent walls, siding, and finishes to provide a complete and weather-tight installation. All debris to be removed and work area left clean upon completion.

Scope limited to new construction roof areas only.

name: Plumbing Rough in Allowance
description:
Plumbing – Rough-In
Provide all labor, materials, and equipment to complete rough plumbing for remodel and addition areas, including removal and replacement of existing water supply, waste, and vent piping as required. Scope includes rough-in for expanded kitchen, exterior hose bib, refrigerator water line, and installation of venting through roof. Includes installation and connection of  water heater, system tie-in to existing plumbing, pressure testing, and preparation for inspection. All work to meet current plumbing code requirements.

Final water heater type and location to be confirmed prior to installation. Any modifications required for venting, electrical, or structural support beyond standard installation to be addressed as needed.

name: Plumbing Finish Items Allowance
description:
Kitchen sink/Faucet combo, garbage disposal, pantry sink/faucet combo, Hose bibs. Water Heater (1500 allowance)

Final fixture selections to be confirmed prior to installation.

name: Plumbing – Finish Installation
description: Provide all labor and materials to complete finish plumbing installation including installation and connection of kitchen sink, faucets, dishwasher. Scope includes final connections to previously roughed-in plumbing systems, testing for proper operation, and verification of leak-free performance.

name: Material Price Volatility Allowance (Market Conditions)
description: This project includes materials subject to market volatility, including petroleum-based products, piping, and other commodities impacted by supply chain conditions and tariffs. Pricing is based on current supplier quotes. Any significant cost increases prior to material procurement will be reviewed with the Owner and addressed through a Change Order prior to purchase.

name: Electrical Rough in Allowance
description:
Electrical – Rough-In & Panel Work
Provide all labor, materials, and equipment to complete electrical rough-in for remodel and addition areas, including demolition and reconfiguration of existing wiring to accommodate new layout. Scope includes installation of new circuits for kitchen appliances, lighting, relocation and extension of existing circuits as required, and installation of new recessed lighting locations, exhaust fan rough-in, and device box placement.

Includes installation of new electrical panel, service modifications, arc fault and GFCI protection as required, extension of service conductors, and coordination of all required permits and inspections. All work to meet current electrical code requirements and be prepared for rough inspection.
Final device, lighting, and fixture locations to be confirmed prior to installation. Any changes after rough-in or additional circuit requirements beyond original scope may result in additional costs.

name: Electrical Finish Items Allowance
description: All lighting fixtures for kitchen and pantry ceiling, under cabinet lighting, toe kick lighting, exterior lighting fixtures and basement lighting as needed.

name: Electrical – Finish Installation
description:
Provide all labor and materials to complete finish electrical installation including installation of lighting fixtures, switches, receptacles, and device covers, as well as final connections for all kitchen appliances, exhaust fans. Scope includes trim-out of electrical panel, installation of breakers, and labeling of circuits.

Includes testing of all electrical systems for proper operation and completion of final inspection in accordance with current electrical code requirements. 
Final fixture, device, and equipment selections to be confirmed prior to installation. Any modifications required due to fixture specifications or changes after rough-in may result in additional costs.

name: Electrical Service Upgrade & Power Drop Relocation Allowance
description:
Provide labor and materials to upgrade existing electrical service to meet current code requirements associated with relocation of the overhead power service drop.

Scope includes installation of new 200-amp service disconnect, service mast, wiring, and associated components required to receive utility power. Work includes coordination with local utility provider and jurisdiction for service disconnect and reconnection.

All work to be performed in accordance with applicable codes and utility requirements, including permitting and inspections as required.

name: Material Price Volatility Allowance (Market Conditions)
description: This project includes materials subject to market volatility, including petroleum-based products, piping, and other commodities impacted by supply chain conditions and tariffs. Pricing is based on current supplier quotes. Any significant cost increases prior to material procurement will be reviewed with the Owner and addressed through a Change Order prior to purchase.

name: HVAC Modifications & Heat Pump Relocation (Allowance)
description:
Provide allowance for relocation of existing heat pump unit and associated mechanical modifications as required to accommodate new construction.

Scope includes disconnecting and relocating existing heat pump unit, modification or replacement of refrigerant lines, reconnection of electrical components, system evacuation, and recharge of refrigerant.

Allowance also includes modifications to existing ductwork to provide conditioned air to new kitchen and pantry areas, including installation of new supply runs, registers, and necessary adjustments to maintain balanced system performance.

Final scope and cost to be adjusted based on field conditions and coordination with HVAC contractor once layout and equipment locations are confirmed.

Any required upgrades to system capacity or major equipment replacement not included.

name: Insulation Allowance
description:
Insulation Installation
Provide all labor and materials to install insulation at all new and affected areas of construction, including exterior walls, ceilings, and floors. Scope includes installation of batt insulation in new 2x6 exterior walls (R21) and furring out existing exterior walls within remodel areas to accommodate insulation (R15).

Includes installation of ceiling insulation to achieve R38 in new and existing kitchen ceiling areas as required, as well as installation of underfloor insulation (R30) at the kitchen and addition floor areas. All work to meet applicable energy code requirements for permitted areas and be prepared for inspection.

Final insulation scope subject to field conditions and framing accessibility. Any additional work required due to existing conditions or access limitations may be addressed as needed.

name: Drywall Installation & FinishingDrywall Installation & Finishing Allowance
description:
Provide all labor and materials to install and finish drywall at kitchen, pantry, and adjacent dining room areas as required for remodel. Scope includes hanging, taping, mudding, sanding, and texture application to match existing adjacent surfaces.

Includes patching and blending at all transitions between new and existing construction, installation of corner bead, and preparation of surfaces ready for primer and paint. All work to be completed in a workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards.

Existing wall and ceiling textures may vary. Exact texture match is not guaranteed, but will be blended to closely match adjacent surfaces.

Texture to match existing as closely as possible; exact match not guaranteed.

name: Interior & Exterior Painting  Allowance
description:
Provide all labor and materials to complete interior and exterior painting at new and remodeled areas. Interior scope includes priming and painting of all new drywall surfaces in kitchen, pantry, and adjacent dining areas, including walls and ceilings.

Exterior scope includes preparation and painting of all new siding and trim areas, including caulking, sealing, and application of finish coatings. All surfaces to receive primer and finish coats as required for proper coverage and durability. Work to be completed in a workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards.

Final colors and finishes to be selected prior to painting. Additional costs may apply for specialty finishes, multiple color changes, or revisions after work has begun.

name: Cabinetry – Supply and Installation Allowance
description:
Cabinetry – Supply and Installation
Provide all labor, materials, and equipment for procurement and installation of cabinetry throughout project, including kitchen cabinets, island, pantry cabinets, and coffee bar.

Scope includes coordination of layout, ordering, delivery, staging, and installation of all cabinetry components. Installation to include leveling, fastening, and alignment of cabinets, as well as integration with adjacent walls, appliances, and fixtures. 

All cabinetry to be installed in accordance with manufacturer specifications and in a workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards.

Final cabinet layout, selections, and finishes to be confirmed prior to order. Any changes after order placement, including modifications to layout, sizing, or materials, may result in additional costs.

name: Countertop Allowance
description:
Allowance for fabrication and installation of countertops including kitchen, island, pantry,

Allowance is based on mid-range material selections. Final material selection, color, style, edge profile, backsplash extent, and layout to be determined. Final cost to be adjusted based on selected materials, finishes, and field measurements.

name: Backsplash Material Allowance
description: Provide allowance for supply of large format tile backsplash materials for kitchen and designated areas. Allowance is based on mid-range material selections. Final tile selection, size, color, and finish to be determined prior to ordering. Material quantities are based on current plan layout and may be adjusted based on final field measurements and selected tile specifications. Any changes in material selection or layout may result in cost adjustments.  (approx.. 60 sq ft )

name: Backsplash Installation Allowance
description: Provide labor and materials required for installation of large format tile backsplash at kitchen and designated areas. Scope includes surface preparation, layout, cutting, setting, grouting, and finishing of tile to achieve a clean and consistent installation. Installation to be performed in accordance with manufacturer specifications and industry standards. Final layout, joint alignment, and edge conditions to be coordinated with selected materials and adjacent finishes. Any additional preparation or modifications required due to field conditions or material selection may result in cost adjustments.

name: Appliances
description: Dishwasher (1200)  Garbage Disposal (200)  Range Hood (600)

name: Appliance Accessories
description: Dishwasher Lines, range hood ducting, Power lines

name: Appliance Installation Allowance
description: Install Dishwasher, prep garbage disposal for installation, install range hood and range hood ductwork, including roof vent

name: Flooring – LVP Allowance
description:
Provide all labor and materials to install luxury vinyl plank (LVP) flooring at kitchen and pantry areas over newly installed subfloor. Scope includes layout, installation, and fitting of flooring to walls, cabinets, and fixtures, as well as installation of transition strips at adjacent flooring surfaces.

All flooring to be installed in accordance with manufacturer specifications and industry standards for a clean and uniform finish.

Final flooring selection and layout to be confirmed prior to installation. Any changes to material specifications, layout direction, or transition conditions may result in additional cost.

Material selection and layout to be confirmed prior to installation.

name: Interior Millwork & Trim Allowance
description:
Provide all labor and materials to complete interior finish carpentry including installation of baseboard, door casings, and window trim at all areas of work. Scope includes installation of trim at all windows replaced within exterior siding areas, including casing and associated trim components, as well as casing installation at four (4) door openings within kitchen area.

Includes cutting, fitting, fastening, and finishing preparation of all trim components to provide a clean and consistent appearance. All work to be installed in a workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards.

Final trim profiles and material selections to be confirmed prior to installation. Any changes to trim style, material, or scope may result in additional cost.

name: Disposal & Dump Fee Allowance
description:
Allowance for disposal of construction debris including demolition materials, framing waste, packaging, and general construction debris generated throughout the project. Includes hauling, transportation, fuel, and dump fees.

Final cost to be adjusted based on actual volume, fuel usage, and disposal fees incurred.

name: Fuel & Transportation Allowance
description:
Allowance for fuel and transportation costs associated with material deliveries, equipment mobilization, and hauling throughout the duration of the project. Includes towing of dump trailer, jobsite visits, and coordination of materials.

Final cost to be adjusted based on actual fuel usage and market conditions.

name: Temporary Sanitation (Portable Toilet & Handwash Station)
description:
Provide portable toilet and handwashing station for jobsite use for the duration of construction. Scope includes delivery, placement, and monthly rental of portable toilet with bi-weekly service and maintenance.

Handwashing station to be provided on site for crew use and maintained in a clean and functional condition throughout the project duration.

Units to remain on site for the duration of active construction and be removed upon project completion.

We include a handwash station on all our projects to keep things clean, safe and professional on site.

name: Project Management & Coordination
description:
Provide project management services including scheduling, coordination of subcontractors, material procurement and delivery coordination, site supervision, and communication throughout the duration of the project. Scope includes oversight of construction activities, coordination of inspections, and management of project timeline to ensure efficient and orderly progression of work.

Project management services are required to coordinate multiple trades, materials, and inspections associated with this project.
